integrity: The proof is analytic; numerical checks only verify constants and identities. Classical Gaussian covariance decomposition is credited as background; originality is limited to its exact Maxway size implication and alignment-sensitive validity phase.
primary_subject_evidence: The direct source is arXiv Statistics Methodology and JRSS Series B statistical methodology; ownership is recorded at permitted broad MSC 62.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to scalar jointly Gaussian linear null models with a fixed linear reduced adjustment and exact reduced conditional resampling.
The p-value is the ideal infinite-randomization p-value; finite Monte Carlo budgets are not analyzed.
The alignment formula is not asserted for general nonlinear or non-Gaussian reductions.
title: Exact Gaussian size law and alignment phase for reduced-adjustment Maxway CRT
